description: WP-S4 Space Wolves HEALING BALMS (Wolf Priest) and HUNTING HOUNDS (Fenrisian Wolves). Fixture sw11e_s4_command (P1 Space Wolves' Command phase, round 2): the Wolf Priest leads Blood Claws that lost 2 models and a wound; Fenrisian Wolves (printed OC 0) stand alone on the centre objective with a Wolf Guard Battle Leader 4" away. Entering the Command phase opens P1's phase_start window with the Healing Balms card; a real click heals D3+1 (the wounded Blood Claw first, then destroyed models return with 1 W). Hunting Hounds: each Fenrisian Wolf has OC 1, so they control the centre objective (objective panel); with the Battle Leader moved away (setup privilege) their OC is 0 and the objective is uncontrolled.
